# Transformer.gg

> Transformer.gg is the agentic influencer marketplace. Real creators, paid on confirmed posts. Run it from the dashboard or from your agent. Paid partnerships on X (Twitter): a brand pastes its website, gets suggested X creators matched to it, and sends each an offer with the price and ask prefilled; creators accept, post in their own words with X's Paid partnership label on, submit the post URL (with a screenshot if they like), and get paid once the Transformer team confirms the post. Every offer has a tracked link, so clicks and sales are attributed to the creator who drove them. Brands and creators can work in the web dashboard or hand the job to an agent through the MCP server, the CLI or the REST API.

Key facts:

- Two sides: brands (and the agents running their growth) and creators (and the agents managing their deals). Either side can be a person or an agent; nothing is dashboard-only.
- Platforms: X (Twitter) and LinkedIn today. More networks later.
- Pricing: no subscription, seats or minimums. Brands set the payout per offer. Creators keep 80% of the payout and of any sales commission (Transformer keeps 20%), or 90% (Transformer keeps 10%) on every deal with any brand that signs up from their brand page for as long as that brand is on Transformer. Example: a $250 X post pays the creator $200 (or $225 on a brand they referred).
- Creators never pay to join or to receive offers; Transformer's fee (20% standard, or 10% on creator-referred brands) comes out of the brand's payment. Creators keep 90% on every deal with any brand that signs up from their brand page.
- Every sponsored post on Transformer carries X's Paid partnership label on X (or a clear paid partnership disclosure on LinkedIn).
- Brand flow: website → suggested creators (matched from the brand's site) → choose a single post, a launch package targeting a launch day, or an open-brief campaign → send binding offers (sending is free) → the creator accepts (or counters) → the brand's saved card is charged automatically at that moment (balance first; a 72-hour pay link only if that charge fails) → the brand approves the creator's post draft → the creator posts → the Transformer team confirms the post → the creator's share is released. Offers are binding: if the creator accepts in time, the card is charged. Money from a declined or expired offer goes back to the brand's balance for the next offer.
- Open briefs: brands can also post an open brief (what they're launching, URL, target launch date or flexible, talking points, budget and creator count). Signed-up creators browse open briefs and apply with their proposed price (prefilled from their rate card or influencer value) and a short note. When a brand accepts an application, it converts directly into a standard binding offer with the same card charge, draft approval, confirmation and payout lifecycle.
- Offers come from the brand: a brand connects one X account (its company account or the sender's own) once, and every send needs it. Creators not on Transformer get the offer as a DM from that account (one-to-one, only if their profile invites business contact and they accept its DMs), and by email from Transformer on the brand's behalf where we have an address. Sending without it returns 409 brand_x_required with a connect link.
- A card on file to send: a brand adds a card once (Stripe). Sending is free; when a creator accepts, the saved card is charged automatically (the brand's balance first). If that charge fails, the brand has 72 hours to pay by link (reminders at 24 and 60 hours); unpaid, the offer is cancelled and the creator is told. The creator posts only after the brand has paid, within 7 days of the payment.
- Payment is held when the brand pays for an offer and released after the Transformer team confirms the post: a person reviews the creator's evidence (the post URL, an optional screenshot of the Paid partnership label, and automatic checks that it's live, from the right account, with the tracked link and the label on) and approves or rejects it with a reason; a rejected post can be fixed and resubmitted before the post-by date. The payment goes back to the brand's balance if the creator declines, the offer expires, or the brand cancels before acceptance; after the brand has paid either side can open a dispute, which freezes the payment until an admin releases or refunds it. When the post is confirmed, the creator's share (80%, or 90% on brands they referred) goes into their balance; creators request a payout (from $10) and are paid by PayPal or USDC (Solana or Base), usually within 3 business days.
- Creators sign in with X read-only. Transformer never posts on a creator's behalf.
- An ask, not a script: creators write their own posts.
- Attribution: each accepted offer gets a tracked link (https://transformer.gg/r/<code>) that appends a tf_click id to the brand's URL. The brand reports sales with POST /api/v1/conversions and commission is calculated per sale. Per-creator landing pages and a visit pixel are supported.
- Agent access: MCP server at https://transformer.gg/mcp (streamable HTTP), REST API at https://transformer.gg/api/v1, CLI installed with `curl -fsSL https://transformer.gg/install | sh`. MCP clients that support sign-in (Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor, …) just add the URL and sign in with X, picking the workspace the agent acts for (OAuth 2.1, revocable in Settings → Agents). Headless agents, the REST API and the CLI use a workspace API key (tf_live_…) as a bearer token; one key or connection acts for exactly one brand or creator workspace.
- Operated by North Bay Opco I, Inc. (a Delaware corporation), Miami, Florida. Support: support@transformer.gg.
- Transformer.gg is part of North Bay Ventures. Founded by Jon Oringer, who founded Shutterstock and took it public. Transformer is not part of Shutterstock. About: https://transformer.gg/about

## Three ways brands run sponsorships

Brands can run sponsorships on Transformer.gg in three ways. All three work across X and LinkedIn and follow the same rules: sending or posting is free, your saved card is charged only when a deal is accepted (balance first), you review the creator's post draft before it goes live, and payment is released after the Transformer team confirms the live post. Details: https://transformer.gg/docs#formats

- **Single post (Book one creator):** Pick one specific creator on X or LinkedIn directly, set your ask and price, and send a binding offer (REST: POST /api/v1/offers; MCP: create_offer or send_offers). Best for testing a channel or booking a specific creator quickly.
- **Launch package (Coordinate a launch day):** Pick a launch date (UTC) and posting window (default 24 hours) and book multiple X and LinkedIn creators to post together in one window (1 to 50 creators per call, add more creators to the same launch later, and optionally open the brief for creator applications too; REST: POST /api/v1/launch-packages; MCP: create_launch_package). Best for product launches, major releases, and announcement days.
- **Campaign / Open brief (Run an open brief):** Write one brief for an ongoing push (product, URL, talking points, optional budget and creator count), let matching signed-up creators apply with their proposed price and a short note, and accept the ones you like (or add multiple creators over time). Accepting an application converts it into a standard binding offer (REST: POST /api/v1/briefs with isOpen: true; MCP: create_brief, list_brief_applications, accept_brief_application). Best for steady, ongoing awareness and inbound creator discovery.

## Influencer values

- [Influencer values by creator](https://transformer.gg/value/creators): Transformer's estimate for one sponsored X post (its influencer value) for creators in tech, AI and the creator economy, shown as a range (from follower count on a published curve, adjusted gently for views, engagement and followers-to-following ratio). Not offers, and not what brands have paid. Creators can remove their page.
- [Index (Markdown)](https://transformer.gg/value/index.md) and [index (JSON)](https://transformer.gg/value/index.json): every page with its value range; each page also has a Markdown version at https://transformer.gg/value/<handle>.md.
- [Check any X handle](https://transformer.gg/value): enter a handle to see its influencer value, Transformer's estimate of one sponsored X post, shown as a range.
- Free MCP tool: get_influencer_value {handle} at https://transformer.gg/mcp/public needs no API key (rate-limited); signed-in agents have it on https://transformer.gg/mcp too. It returns the same range, usual price and method line as the page, with a link.

## For brands

- Who it's for: brands that want sponsored posts from X creators in tech, AI, dev tools, SaaS, crypto and finance, and the agents running their growth. Free to join and to send offers; no subscription and no minimum offer; Transformer keeps 20% of each payout.
- Start here: [For brands](https://transformer.gg/brands) shows how many X creators in our index meet our bar, by niche (live counts, also in [Markdown](https://transformer.gg/brands.md)), example prices per post, and how a deal works.
- Who the creators are: X accounts in our index with real followings (1,000+ followers and at least 3 followers for each account they follow), recent posts and good engagement for their size. Most haven't joined Transformer yet. An offer reaches them as a DM from the brand's X account or by email; today about 4 in 10 of them can receive one, and that share grows as we find more contact details.
- What a post costs: each creator has an influencer value, our estimate for one sponsored post, shown as a range on https://transformer.gg/value/<handle>. A creator's own price replaces it. Rates by size: [Sponsored post rates by follower count](https://transformer.gg/blog/sponsored-post-rates-by-follower-count) and [How much to pay an influencer](https://transformer.gg/blog/how-much-to-pay-an-influencer).
- Who already sponsors X creators: [Which brands sponsor X creators](https://transformer.gg/blog/which-brands-sponsor-x-creators), updated monthly from disclosed paid-partnership posts.
- Browse creators by niche: [Influencer values by creator](https://transformer.gg/value/creators).
- First campaign: [How to run an influencer campaign on X](https://transformer.gg/blog/how-to-run-an-influencer-campaign-on-x).
